reference_method: Official get_metadata, full high fidelity get_design_context and get_screenshot; saved original PNGs. No reconstruction or approximate asset recreation.
comparisons: Root inspected all4 official full-frame PNGs and final db899 fourwide/foursmall original native PNGs, plus Gemini small scroll/max and keyboardfocus capture. This is full-frame first review with recorded differences, not final acceptance.
known_differences: Real OS titlebar and extra captured row; originals retained without crop/scale.
Native close button vector and shared scrim color remain visually different.
Actual provider model names, empty mappings, unconfigured modes, port and log state differ from static example.
Figma static mapping row containers overlap or clip oversized child input; real native inputs remain operable and independently scrollable.
All full-frame final acceptance and unsupported platform/accessibility/IME evidence remain incomplete.
Chat Select populated value ink remains3px lower after OS-row accounting, mapping heading2px lower; precise fields/footer typography and optical offsets remain follow-up work, not silently accepted.
contrast_scope: Computed intended flat color pairs only. Muted secondary matches explicit Figma but is below4.5:1 for small normal text; not accessibility acceptance. Does not test compositing, glyph AA or actual screen-reader behavior.

native_default_review.method: Original own-PID native screencapture PNGs, no cropping/scaling/redrawing. Extra OS row retained.
native_default_review.default_values: Chat/Responses Protocol default and Native effort, empty mappings; Anthropic4096/Unconfigured/version2023-06-01; GeminiUnconfigured. Prototype sample modes not imposed.
native_default_review.small: Inner scroll reaches max; fixed header/tabs and Apply footer remain readable. Top field is clipped naturally inside body scroll when scrolled to end, below fixed tabs.
native_default_review.keyboard: Agent observed each4tab click then Return and Space preserve corresponding modal/tab, no Apply. Native focus image retains semantic primary border; default Figma state uses D5D1FF.
